fusions.name: Ripened Windfall
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second wait, drops a heavy ripe fruit that deals 32 damage and bursts for 80% of that on enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hedgerow Browse
fusions.desc: Crops the hedge around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Shelterbelt
fusions.desc: Spreads your branches over the ally who needs it most, restoring 3 health a second to them for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow-Grazed Rings
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
